verdict.rationale: Claude Code's docs describe CLAUDE.md, a markdown file added to the project root that Claude Code reads at the start of every session and that is meant for coding standards, architecture decisions, preferred libraries and review checklists. A daily user confirms relying on CLAUDE.md guide rails, though they report needing ever-larger files. missing for 10: in-depth documentation (file scoping or hierarchy, nested or user-level files), independent evidence that the agent reliably follows the stated conventions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a project instructions file to set coding standards and conventions the agent follows

citations.quote: CLAUDE.md is a markdown file you add to your project root that Claude Code reads at the start of every session. Use it to set coding standards, architecture decisions, preferred libraries, and review checklists.
I've found that I have to add more and more CLAUDE.md guide rails
